name: foreverworks-app-stores
description: Read and answer App Store and Google Play reviews, and see TestFlight feedback and crash logs.

asc_key_id.title: App Store Connect key id
asc_key_id.description: For the App Store: the App Store Connect API key's id (10 characters).

asc_issuer_id.title: App Store Connect issuer id
asc_issuer_id.description: For the App Store: the issuer id App Store Connect shows above your team keys.

asc_private_key_file.title: App Store Connect key (.p8)
asc_private_key_file.description: For the App Store: path of the .p8 key file App Store Connect let you download.

play_service_account_file.title: Google Play service account key
play_service_account_file.description: For Google Play: path of the service account's JSON key.

play_packages.title: Google Play package names
play_packages.description: For Google Play: the package names to answer for, comma-separated, e.g. com.example.app.
